title: Guitar with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='8' width='12' height='38' rx='2' fill='#c97b3d'/>
  <!-- neck highlight -->
  <rect x='46' y='8' width='3' height='38' rx='1' fill='#e8a55e'/>
  <!-- frets -->
  <rect x='44' y='18' width='12' height='2' fill='#f0f0f0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='28' width='12' height='2' fill='#f0f0f0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='38' width='12' height='2' fill='#f0f0f0'/>
  <!-- headstock -->
  <rect x='40' y='2' width='20' height='12' rx='3' fill='#8b4a1e'/>
  <!-- tuning pegs -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='6' r='2.5' fill='#ffd700'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='11' r='2.5' fill='#ffd700'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='6' r='2.5' fill='#ffd700'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='11' r='2.5' fill='#ffd700'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#d4853f'/>
  <!-- body upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='14' fill='#d4853f'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='60' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#e8a55e' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- sound hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='64' r='8' fill='#4a2a0a'/>
  <!-- sound hole glow rim -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='64' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#ffcf70' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='47' y1='10' x2='47' y2='90' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='10' x2='50' y2='92' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='10' x2='53' y2='90' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='40' y='82' width='20' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8b4a1e'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='72' r='4' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='72' r='4' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <!-- eye sparkle -->
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='70.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='70.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 80 Q50 90 60 80' fill='none' stroke='#1a1a2e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='79' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='79' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
